measurementRules.rule: Q is the sum of independently measured net masses of uniquely identified complete buildings first released in the reporting cohort. Weigh complete configured units with calibrated scales or a traceable complete-kit mass reconciliation under cp_release. Include actual integral constituents and retained fluids once; exclude transport packaging and temporary jigs. Never infer unit mass from dimensions, density or a generic building count.

Collect undivided raw quantities in original units. Convert rate/units and perform justified attribution before the single calculation in §8. Same-reference cards and protocol aggregation refer to that same calculation; no later second division. Q=0 retains actual burdens and inventory vectors but yields no unit result.

Procure each supplied formulation as a whole once. Assay, monomer, solvent and carrier-water contents are non-additive subledgers, not extra purchases. Separately added substances cross as their own actual flows. Record wet mass, free/retained/structural water and reaction stoichiometry independently; thermoset cure is not upstream polyester polycondensation. Do not fit two unknowns with one mass residual.

Use the native energy property with its energy unit group; 1 kWh=3.6 MJ. The adopted MVAC identity is restricted to CN 1–35 kV consumption mix at user, grid-average supply. Other voltage/geography or a separate transformation service requires a compatible atomic row without buying the same power twice.

Count and item are the same physical count only when the unit chain confirms factor1. Convert actual item/area/volume records to mass only with measured same-configuration net mass, surveyed face/layer scope or substance-specific density at recorded T/P/phase. A secondary volume property is not independent density evidence. Integrated volume is already an integral; multiply only a genuine rate by its actual duration. Whole-building M belongs only to that complete configuration. Each component or packaging count needs its own independently evidenced same-article/state mass bridge; do not multiply panel/bolt/package counts by building M.

calculationRules.rule: A_native = converted raw measured exchange; convert kWh to MJ with factor3.6 and weigh/convert physical units only with independent same-state evidence. Integrated quantities are not multiplied by duration again. Preserve raw original values and conversion uncertainty.

A = directly assigned or justified allocated A_native after dedicated/virtual subdivision, exchange-specific causality and only the genuine residual common-process allocation. For each exchange, add the actual opening-WIP vector to current assigned raw burden and subtract the actual closing-WIP and separately traced other-destination vectors; preserve raw-stock inherited vectors on actual issue. Released closing FG is already in Q and is not subtracted. Retain true losses and zero-output intervals. Gross physical article/fluid/waste/packaging movements remain full actual quantities, not burden-share-scaled quantities.

Convert actual native extensive units once. Physical V/Qanalysis or Qt/Qanalysis discloses the one actual whole event/provider quantity once, not a full shared provider link per cohort. Separately compute each original served cohort modeled A/originalQ0 or Ah/originalQc using evidenced nonoverlapping vectors and compatible units. A=Bopen+U_new−Bclose−Tother uses U_new BEFORE stock correction and only genuinely unused raw/WIP carry; never acceptedFG or performedservice, no second correction or repeated own/provider history. Zero/unknown basis retainsrawtotals and unresolvedunitresult.

Match sender/receiver transfer IDs and physical mass plus every inherited exchange vector. Cancel equal internal movements at consolidation; actual external supplied article or separately purchased disjoint constituents enter once. Never add a supplied article mass and its already-included formulation/fibre/core again.

Keep independent total wet-mass and relevant element balances: opening + gross receipts = closing + all gross external outputs, including actual emissions/losses. Independently evidenced chemical formation/consumption applies to species balances only and must conserve the total-mass and element gates. Include actual phase-crossing water/gas quantities, not invented mass. Cancel matching internal transfers. Every flow has its own inherited burden vector; retain the complete wet closing stock. Do not use X except removal of a duplicate same-side OTHER record of the same actual event. Species and free/retained/reaction/phase water require independent observations; one residual cannot resolve two unknowns.

Convert actual native extensive units once. Physical V/Qanalysis or Qt/Qanalysis discloses the one actual whole event/provider quantity once, not a full shared provider link per cohort. Separately compute each original served cohort modeled A/originalQ0 or Ah/originalQc using evidenced nonoverlapping vectors and compatible units. A=Bopen+U_new−Bclose−Tother uses U_new BEFORE stock correction and only genuinely unused raw/WIP carry; never acceptedFG or performedservice, no second correction or repeated own/provider history. Zero/unknown basis retainsrawtotals and unresolvedunitresult.

For each original cohort preserve its first-release manufacturing vector once and add only actual H service increments normalized on the same original Qc. Internal release-to-services product transfers cancel; closing FG remains stock and already counted first-release Q is not reduced. Gross physical dispatch/return/removed-part/waste/fluid records remain full native quantities over original Qc. Preserve original-dispatch reversal and actual incremental rework attribution; no future service forecast is presented as executed work.

measurementRules.rule: Q为报告批次内首次放行、唯一识别的完整建筑独立实测净质量之和。按cp_release以校准衡器称量完整配置，或采用可追溯齐套质量核对。实际内含组分及留存流体只计一次；排除运输包装和临时工装。不从尺寸、密度或通用建筑计数推算件重。
采集未除分母的原始数量及原始单位。先完成真实速率/单位转换及有据归属，再执行第8节唯一归一计算。卡片和协议汇总引用同一次计算，之后不得再次除法。Q=0保留真实负荷及库存继承向量，不出单位结果。
每种外购制剂按整份采购一次。含量、单体、溶剂及载水仅为非加和子账，不再采购。现场另加物质按独立真实流入账。独立记录湿质量、游离/留存/结构水及反应计量；热固交联不等同上游聚酯缩聚。不能用一个质量残差拟合两个未知。
沿用原生能量属性及能量单位组；1 kWh=3.6 MJ。采用的中压交流电身份仅适用于中国1–35 kV用户端电网平均消费组合。其他电压/地理或另列变压服务必须采用兼容原子行，不能重复购买同一电量。
仅当单位链确认因子1时Count/item才为相同物理计数。件数、面积或体积转质量仅可用同配置实测净质量、实测单面/层面几何或记录温压相态下该物质独立密度。次级体积属性不是独立密度证据。累积体积已经积分，只有真实速率才乘实际历时。 整建筑M仅属该完整配置；各部件包装件数须独立同制品状态质量桥，不以建筑M乘板螺栓包装件数。

calculationRules.rule: A_native为转换后的原始实测交换；kWh按因子3.6转MJ，物理单位仅以独立同状态证据称量/转换。累积量不得再次乘历时。保留原值及换算不确定性。
A为A_native经专属/虚拟子划分、逐交换因果归属及仅真实剩余共同过程分配后的量。逐交换将真实期初WIP向量加当期归属原始负荷，减真实期末WIP及独立追踪其他去向向量；原料库存继承向量随真实领用承接。放行期末FG已在Q中，不予扣减。保留真实损失及零产出区间。整件/流体/废物/包装毛物理移动仍为完整真实数量，不能按负荷份额缩减。

匹配发出接收交接ID及物理质量和每个继承交换向量。合并抵消相同内部移动；真实外购整件或互斥单独外购组分仅进入一次。不得整件质量再加已含制剂/玻纤/芯材。
独立保留总湿质量及相关元素平衡：期初+毛流入=期末+全部毛对外流出，含真实排放损失。独立有据化学生成/消耗仅用于物种平衡，且须守恒总质量及元素门。纳入真实跨相态水气量，不虚构质量。匹配内部交接抵消。每流有自身继承负荷向量；保留完整湿期末库存。X仅用于同侧OTHER中相同真实事件的重复记录去重。物种及游离/留存/反应/相态水须独立观测，一个残差不能解两个未知。
